title: Human Crossing Road Properties
description: Detects instances of humans crossing a road within a defined surveillance zone. Captures object classification type, associated vehicle view (if applicable), and zone information. Use this event when queries involve pedestrian movement, jaywalking detection, or road-crossing analysis.

vehicle_view.description: View or orientation context associated with the detection frame, if applicable.

type.description: Classification of the detected object (e.g., person, pedestrian).

zoneId.description: Identifier of the zone where the human crossing event was detected.
